description: AWA design-system coverage matrix. Measured fields are generated by scripts/design-system-inventory.js; status / batch / exception / notes / migratedBaseline are maintained by hand.

statusDefinitions.not-started: The file uses its own literals (colours, font sizes, radii) and no design-system token or shared component.
statusDefinitions.tokens: The file reads the Phase 1 token modules (useAwaTokens, typescale, shapes, roles …) but still renders its own controls.
statusDefinitions.migrated: The file uses the shared src/components/ui components and has no raw hex / fontSize / borderRadius / serif literal beyond its recorded migratedBaseline and its documented exceptions.
statusDefinitions.exception: The file deliberately keeps its own styling (brand asset, native dialog, calibrated layout); the reason is mandatory and listed in EXCEPTIONS.md.

Pilot 1, final state: profile icon, eyebrow, heading, short subtitle (formSubtitle), labelled outlined input (placeholder formPlaceholder) with counter, primary button (17 sp / 700), helper line (formFooter). Uses AwaText / AwaButton / AwaIcon; the native TextInput, its animated focus ring, the save logic and the empty-name behaviour are unchanged. Block raised in the upper part of the screen (free space split 1:2 above / below, not centred). No decorative circles and no radius literals. Code-validated only; device review pending.
